name: LMSubs
description: OpenAI-compatible ASR (speech-to-text) + LLM subtitle translation. Adds native 'LM 字幕' / 'LM 字幕（实时）' subtitle tracks: selecting one starts transcription at the current playback position, using cache when possible. No web modification. Configurable Base URL / API Key / Model.
overview: ASR 语音转写 + LLM 字幕翻译（原生字幕轨，零 Web 修改）

versions.changelog: Native LM subtitle tracks in every client; position-first pipeline with disk cache; live track re-transcribes and overwrites; removed web injection.
